messages.content: "Can you help me with a few things? First, I need to update my user information in the CustomerInfo database. My user ID is 12345, and I want to change my name to John Doe and my email to johndoe@example.com. Second, I'm curious about the last match played by the soccer club Manchester United, and I'd like to know the match statistics as well. Third, I'm doing a history project and need to know who the U.S. president was in the year 1980, and I'd like the full name with middle initial if applicable. Lastly, I'm playing a card game and need to find the Ace of Spades in a standard 52 card deck. Can you assist with these?"

function.name: find_card_in_deck
function.description: Locate a particular card in a deck based on rank and suit. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

rank.description: Rank of the card (e.g. Ace, Two, King).

suit.description: Suit of the card (e.g. Hearts, Spades, Diamonds, Clubs).

deck.description: Deck of cards. If not provided, the deck will be default to an empty array

function.name: soccer_get_last_match
function.description: Retrieve the details of the last match played by a specified soccer club. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the soccer club.

include_stats.description: If true, include match statistics like possession, shots on target etc. Default is false.

function.name: US_president_in_year
function.description: Retrieve the name of the U.S. president in a given year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

full_name.description: Option to return full name with middle initial, if applicable.

function.name: update_user_info
function.description: Update user information in the database. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The user ID of the customer.

database.description: The database where the user's information is stored.
